name: Shoeboxed
summary: Turn paper and digital receipts into organized, IRS-ready expense data with OCR plus human verification — syncs with QuickBooks and Xero.
best_for: businesses drowning in PAPER receipts — trades, field crews, owners with shoeboxes of history — who want them humanly digitized, verified and IRS-ready
skip_if: your receipts are mostly digital already (lighter OCR apps cost less), or your accountant's tooling ingests receipts natively
honest_knock: Its unique trick is the Magic Envelope, where you literally mail a stuffed envelope of paper receipts and humans digitize them. That trick is also the meter to watch: envelope frequency defines the tiers, and heavy paper businesses land in the $179/mo bracket quickly. If your receipts are already digital, cheaper scan-only apps exist; Shoeboxed earns its price precisely when physical paper is the problem.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-08-31 against the vendor's own pricing page) (2026) Four plans, each quoted both yearly and monthly: Starter $97/yr or $9/mo (30 digital scans/mo, 20 paper scans/yr, 1 Magic Envelope/yr, 1 user, 3 years of scan storage); Pro $297/yr or $29/mo (200 digital scans/mo, 20 paper scans/mo, 1 Magic Envelope per quarter, Gmail receipt sync, QuickBooks Online/Xero, 3 users); Plus $797/yr or $79/mo (750 digital scans/mo, 50 paper scans/mo, 1 Magic Envelope/mo, 10 users); Paper Plus $1,997/yr or $179/mo (500 digital scans/mo, 200 paper scans/mo, 2 envelopes/mo). Overages by tier: $0.30/$0.15/$0.10 per digital scan, $2.00 or $1.50 per paper scan, $9 per extra envelope. Unlimited mileage tracking on every plan. A 30-day money-back guarantee rather than a free trial — the card is charged at signup, and the vendor asks you not to claim the refund once a Magic Envelope has shipped.
